Privacy policy

VVollet is a budgeting app. To work out what you can spend, it needs the numbers you type into it. This page explains what we keep, where it lives, who else sees any of it, and how to have it deleted.

On this page

Who we are

VVollet is published by Taha Mohamed Adib, an individual developer based in Morocco, who is responsible for your data under Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of personal data and, for people in the European Union, under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Questions or requests: support@vvollet.com

What we collect

WhatWhy
Account details Your email address and a hashed password, or the identifier Google or Apple gives us if you sign in with them. A display name if you set one. Used to sign you in and keep your data in your account.
Financial records you enter Accounts and balances, cash, transactions, categories and budgets, bills and subscriptions, savings goals, debts, money lent or borrowed, and Daret groups. Used to show your balances and organize your finances.
Photos you add Receipt photos, account logos and a profile picture, only when you choose to add one. Location and camera details (EXIF data) are removed before upload.
Settings Language, currency, pay day, monthly income and display preferences. Your app PIN is kept only on your device, in its secure storage.

VVollet does not connect to your bank. Everything in it is something you typed or added yourself.

Why we’re allowed to use it

  • To provide the app you asked for: your account details, the records you enter, your photos and settings. Without them VVollet can’t work.
  • Your consent: signing in with Google or Apple, and any optional feature that asks for permission first. You can withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect what was done before.
  • Legal obligations: answering requests about your rights and keeping records the law requires.

We only use your data to run VVollet for you. We don’t use it to profile you or make automated decisions about you.

What we don’t do

  • We don’t sell your data or share it for advertising.
  • We don’t show ads.
  • We don’t use analytics, tracking or crash-reporting tools.
  • We don’t read your contacts, messages or location.

Where it’s stored

When you sign in, your data is saved to your VVollet account on Supabase, the database and file storage service we use. Database rules make sure each record can only be read by the account that created it. A copy is also kept on your phone so the app works offline, and it syncs when you’re back online.

If you use VVollet in local mode, without an account, your data stays on your device and is not sent to us.

Supabase stores data on servers outside Morocco, run on Amazon Web Services. This means your data is transferred abroad. We rely on Supabase’s data processing agreement, which includes the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses, to protect it, and on the transfer rules of Moroccan Law 09-08. You can ask us for details of these safeguards.

Services that receive data

ServiceWhat it receives
SupabaseEverything listed above, to store your account, data and photos. Supabase also sends the emails needed for your account, such as confirming your address or resetting your password.
Google or AppleOnly if you choose to sign in with them. They confirm who you are and share your email address with us.

Features not yet available

The AI Coach and Investments are not available yet. Before either is switched on, we will update this policy to name any new service involved (such as an AI provider or a stock price provider) and the data it receives. The AI Coach will also ask for your permission before anything is sent.

Device permissions

  • Camera: only when you choose to take a photo, for example of a receipt.
  • Photos: only when you choose a picture from your library.
  • Internet: to sync your data with your account.

Keeping and deleting

We keep your data for as long as you have an account. You can delete individual records in the app at any time.

To delete your account and everything in it, follow the steps on Delete your account. We delete your account, financial records and photos within 30 days of your request. You can also delete your account yourself in the app, from Settings.

Our hosting provider keeps encrypted backups for disaster recovery. Deleted data can stay in those backups for up to 30 more days, until they are overwritten. It is not used or restored during that time.

Your rights

You can ask us at any time to:

  • give you a copy of your data (you can also export it yourself from Settings → Data & storage);
  • correct anything that is wrong;
  • delete your data;
  • limit how we use it, or stop processing it;
  • give your data to you in a format you can move to another service.

Email support@vvollet.com from the address on your account. We reply within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to Morocco’s data protection authority, the CNDP (cndp.ma), or to the authority where you live.

Security

Data travels to and from our servers over encrypted connections (HTTPS). Database rules keep each person’s records separate. In the app, you can add a PIN lock and hide your balances in the app switcher. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong password and keep your phone locked.

Children

VVollet is not meant for children under 16, and we don’t knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we’ll delete it.

This website

vvollet.com uses no cookies, analytics or third-party scripts. It is hosted by Vercel, which, like any web host, keeps short-lived server logs of requests (including your IP address and browser type) to deliver the site and protect it from abuse. We don’t use these logs to identify you.

Changes

If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page. If a change affects what we collect or who receives it, we will also tell you in the app.
